ignoreValues.reason: Markdown-blockquote rule for rendered issue bodies (.detail .body blockquote): neutral --border-2 token at 3px, not an accent side-tab on a card.

Two intentional sites: .site-shot animates width/height so object-fit re-crops at native resolution (a transform would magnify a 34x24 crop 4.4x into mush); .resizer::before is an absolutely-positioned 1px hairline that must land on device pixels. Both off under prefers-reduced-motion.
